description: This file contains functions for preparing environments, reading and writing bytes to memory technology devices (MTD), and setting flags on I-O DATA devices manufactured by MitraStar Technology Corp. It appears to be part of a firmware or embedded system upgrade utility related to OpenWrt, a Linux-based firmware for embedded devices.

methods.name: iodata_mstc_prepare_fail
methods.description: Handles failure situations during environment check and preparation, reboots the device.

methods.name: iodata_mstc_rw_byte
methods.description: Reads or writes a single byte in the specified MTD device at a given offset.

methods.name: iodata_mstc_set_flag
methods.description: Sets a specific flag in the MTD device for I-O DATA MSTC devices, including validation and error handling.
